summary: The deploy-root exclusion now covers JavaScript and TypeScript test files, and the new regression test verifies exclusion plus digest stability with JavaScript fixtures.

evidence: The exclusion predicate at scripts/prepare_deploy_root.ts line 530 matches names ending in _test.js, .test.js, _test.ts, and .test.ts, covering both tracked JavaScript test files named in the issue.
The added test at scripts/prepare_deploy_root_test.ts lines 100-148 creates JavaScript and TypeScript test fixtures under public and src and asserts each is absent from the prepared deploy root.

The same test records the digest, edits every test fixture, re-prepares the root, and asserts the digest is unchanged; editing public/workspace-cache.js then changes the digest, so the stability check is meaningful.
No test file was moved, and public/crypto-checkout_test.js remains listed in the deno.json test task, so existing repository test execution is preserved.
